baseDescription:
generate_speech reads written words aloud. It is text-to-speech, not music: use
generate_music for songs, instrumentals and jingles.

THE PROMPT IS THE SCRIPT. Unlike every image and video tool, prompt is not a description
of the output — it is the literal text to be spoken, character for character. Writing "a
calm woman reading the news" produces a voice saying those seven words. Put the delivery in
voiceDescription (for voice/design) or inline acting tags (for drama3) and the actual copy in prompt.

WRITE THE SCRIPT WHEN THE USER DOES NOT. "Read me a haiku about rain", "record a podcast
intro" and "say something reassuring" are requests for words you compose and then speak.
Compose the line and pass it as prompt. Reach for compose_script only for a long or
structured piece; a sentence or two is yours to write.

PICK THE MODEL FROM WHAT THE USER GAVE YOU. When the user asks for Fish Drama 3, Arabic
speech (language="arabic" requires model="drama3"), expressive acting speech, or inline vocal
cues ([sighs], [laughs], [warmly], [gasps], <whisper>...</whisper>), use model="drama3" (with
optional zero-shot voice cloning via voiceSourceIndex / voice_source_url). A voice clip uploaded
with "make it sound like me" is model="clone" with voiceSourceIndex pointing at that upload. A
saved Persona's voice is a clone source too: when the user asks for that persona's own voice, call
resolve_personas and use model="clone" with voiceSourceIndex set to the full voice recording index
it reports. A described speaker who does not exist ("an old lighthouse keeper") is model="design"
with voiceDescription. Anything else is model="voice" — choose a voice from the roster and, if
the user described a mood or a delivery, put that in voiceDescription too.

CLONING QUALITY. Set voiceTranscript whenever the words in the uploaded clip are known: it
is the difference between a close clone and a loose one (up to 1024 chars on clone, 2000 chars on
drama3). Leave it out for a persona recording: the persona's saved transcript is supplied
automatically. Tell the user if their reference is too short, has music under it, or has two people
talking — those are the three reasons a clone comes back sounding wrong.

PUNCTUATION IS PROSODY. Keep full stops, commas and question marks; they control pauses
and intonation. Spell out numbers, dates and abbreviations the way they should be read when the
written form is ambiguous.

To put speech over video, generate it here and then call sound_to_video with the result.
Do not use animate_photo or generate_video to "say" a line of provided text.

parameterDocs.prompt: The literal words to speak, verbatim (up to 4096 chars on voice/clone/design, up to 5000 chars on drama3). With model="drama3", inline [direction] and <whisper>...</whisper> acting tags may be embedded directly in prompt.
parameterDocs.model: Speech engine selector: "voice" (default studio voices), "clone" (Qwen3-TTS voice clone), "design" (invented voice from voiceDescription), or "drama3" (Fish Drama 3 expressive acting voice with inline [direction] tags, Arabic support, and optional voice cloning).
parameterDocs.voice: Preset studio voice for model="voice" only (default serena).
parameterDocs.voiceDescription: Delivery direction for model="voice"; the speaker to invent for model="design". Never sent with model="clone" or model="drama3".
parameterDocs.voiceSourceIndex: Which audio holds the voice to clone, same numbering as other tools use for audio: -1 is the first upload, -2 the second, and 0-based non-negative indices address audio generated earlier. A resolved persona's full voice recording uses the index resolve_personas reports. Required for model="clone" and optional for model="drama3".
parameterDocs.voice_source_url: REST alternative to voiceSourceIndex for clone or optional drama3 reference audio.
parameterDocs.voiceTranscript: What the uploaded clip says. Optional, but it makes the clone markedly closer to the source (up to 1024 chars on clone, 2000 chars on drama3). Omit it for a persona voice recording; its saved transcript is filled in automatically.
parameterDocs.language: Script language or "auto" (default). Qwen3-TTS modes ("voice", "clone", "design") support English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, and Italian; "arabic" requires model="drama3".
parameterDocs.creativity: Qwen3-TTS (voice, clone, design) variation from 0.1 to 2; default 0.9. Omit on model="drama3".
parameterDocs.outputFormat: Audio file format: wav (default), mp3, or flac.
parameterDocs.seed: Optional integer seed for reproducible speech takes.
